description: Overrides for Data Viewer records. At runtime the extension captures every editable field in the selected table's live Add record form and generates a value for fields not listed here. Keys are CDP field IDs without the field- prefix. Tokens {{date}}, {{timestamp}}, {{day}}, {{month}}, {{year}}, {{ddmm}}, {{sequence}}, {{tableSequence}}, {{sourceId}}, and {{objectId}} are generated for every record. SourceID comes from the optional popup value and defaults to UI; Source<Table>ID is generated from the table code, DDMM, and repetition sequence.
